name: 3-CARD BRAG
description: 3-Card Brag is Britain's premier vying (betting) card game and a direct ancestor of modern Poker. Each player receives three cards and competes for a central pot. Its most distinctive feature is the 'Blind' betting system, where a player can bet without looking at their cards for half the cost, maintaining a psychological and mechanical advantage over 'Seeing' players. It is fast, aggressive, and deeply rooted in British pub and gambling traditions.

content.text: 3-Card Brag is Britain's premier vying (betting) card game and a direct ancestor of modern Poker. Each player receives three cards and competes for a central pot. Its most distinctive feature is the 'Blind' betting system, where a player can bet without looking at their cards for half the cost, maintaining a psychological and mechanical advantage over 'Seeing' players. It is fast, aggressive, and deeply rooted in British pub and gambling traditions.

Brag emerged in 16th-century England as a three-card vying game. It evolved into the parent of Indian Teen Patti and influenced the betting structures of early American Poker variants like Three-Card Poker.
Standard pack, betting chips or currency.
Every player contributes an ante. Dealer deals three cards face-down to each player.

items.text: Brag with Braggers: Standard variant where J♣, 9♦, and A♦ are wild cards (Braggers).
